doc.title: Supabase Integration Strategy (ADR-003)
doc.snippet: Backend/Database: Supabase for PostgreSQL, Auth, Storage all-in-one. API Client: @supabase/supabase-js for browser operations. Authentication: @supabase/ssr for cookie-based server-side auth (Story 1.3). Storage: Supabase Storage for encrypted video files (Epic 2). Database: PostgreSQL for work elements, stations, videos (Epic 6).

doc.title: Library Organization
doc.snippet: lib/env.ts - Environment variable validation (Zod). lib/supabase/ - Supabase client setup (client.ts for browser client using @supabase/supabase-js, server.ts for server client using @supabase/ssr for cookie-based auth).

doc.title: Environment Configuration
doc.snippet: Required environment variables: NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL (Supabase project URL), NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY (Supabase anonymous/public key). Validated with Zod in lib/env.ts. Catches configuration errors early before runtime failures.

doc.title: Story Requirements
doc.snippet: Supabase Project Setup & Configuration. Create Supabase project following security best practices. Set up storage bucket with appropriate permissions. Configure environment variables for local development. Install @supabase/supabase-js package. Create Supabase client utility in lib/supabase.ts. Note: Database schema will be created in Epic 6.

doc.title: Secure Video Upload Context
doc.snippet: Epic 2 will use Supabase Storage for encrypted video uploads. Client-side encryption using Web Crypto API (AES-256-GCM) before upload. Storage bucket named 'videos' for encrypted video files. Chunked upload for large files.

doc.title: Code Standards
doc.snippet: Files: Utilities use camelCase.ts (e.g., env.ts, client.ts). Functions: camelCase. Constants: UPPER_SNAKE_CASE. Database: Tables snake_case plural, Columns snake_case, Foreign keys {table}_id.

constraints.constraint: Environment variables must not be committed to git. .env.local is excluded via .gitignore. Never commit Supabase keys to version control. Use NEXT_PUBLIC_ prefix only for client-side accessible variables. Anon key is safe to expose but still don't commit it for security hygiene. Service role key (if needed later) must NEVER be exposed to client.
Use @supabase/ssr for cookie-based server-side authentication (not client-side). Set up middleware.ts for cookie checks before page renders (Story 1.3). HttpOnly cookies prevent XSS token theft.
Follow naming conventions: Files use camelCase.ts (env.ts, client.ts, server.ts). Functions use camelCase. Constants use UPPER_SNAKE_CASE. Maintain consistent code organization.
Environment validation must catch missing/invalid variables at app startup using Zod. Export typed environment object for type-safe access throughout application. Fail fast on configuration errors.

Storage bucket named 'videos' for encrypted video files. Permissions: Authenticated users can upload/read their own videos. File size limit: Configure based on expected video sizes (50-500 MB typical, up to 1 GB max). Note: Encryption happens client-side before upload (Epic 2).

Database schema will be created in Epic 6 (Story 6.1). For this story: Just verify database connection works with simple test query. Tables to be created later: stations, videos, work_elements, categorization_segments.

interface.name: Supabase Browser Client
interface.purpose: Browser-side Supabase client for client components and browser-only operations
interface.usage: Import in client components, hooks, and browser-side logic

interface.name: Supabase Server Client
interface.purpose: Server-side Supabase client factory for server components and API routes with cookie handling
interface.usage: Call createClient() in server components, server actions, and API routes for cookie-based auth

interface.name: Environment Validation
interface.purpose: Type-safe environment variable validation using Zod schema
interface.usage: Import env object anywhere to access validated, type-safe environment variables

interface.name: Environment Template
interface.purpose: Example environment file documenting required variables for local development
interface.template:
# Supabase Configuration # Get these values from: https://supabase.com/dashboard/project/YOUR_PROJECT/settings/api
# Supabase project URL NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL=https://your-project.supabase.co
# Supabase anonymous (public) key - safe to expose to browser NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY=your-anon-key-here
interface.usage: Copy to .env.local and fill in actual Supabase credentials
